summary: Fixed and verified. The bug (the "needle") was in `config.go`: `LoadConfig` never populated `Metrics` when `enable_metrics: true` but no `metrics` object was present in `config.json`, so `main.go`'s status handler dereferenced a nil `*MetricsConfig` pointer and panicked on `/status`. Added a default `MetricsConfig` in `LoadConfig` when metrics are enabled but unconfigured. `test.sh` now passes.
